response.query: What are the top innovative trends in Engineering & Computer Science, especially in security compliance, telemetry architecture, DevOps metrics, longitudinal study methods, and ethical governance?
response.answer: Top trends include AI-driven governance frameworks, telemetry-based security compliance, and DevOps metrics for continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) efficiency. Ethical governance in AI and big data interoperability is also critical.
